mapper.select: SELECT w.user_id AS userId, p.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName FROM wishlist w JOIN products p ON p.product_id = w.product_id WHERE p.discount_price IS NOT NULL AND p.discount_price < p.price AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM notifications nt WHERE nt.user_id = w.user_id AND nt.type = 'WISHLIST' AND nt.ref_id = p.product_id AND nt.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' ) ORDER BY w.user_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, type, message, ref_id, is_read, clicked) VALUES
(#{i.userId}, #{i.type}, #{i.message}, #{i.refId}, false, false)
